data.title: Charles H gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

May 31, 2024

## [Beware shipping and logistical difficulties](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/665982a70b9f448915e9554d)

I ordered an item that was promised to ship in 5-8 business days. It has been twice as long and the item has still not shipped.

Customer service has been responsive by email, but I will be hesitant to purchase any item from Lulu and Georgia in the future, as the shipping and logistics seem to be highly disorganized.

May 30, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 10, 2024

Hi Charles, we’re so sorry about the continued delays you experienced, and for the lack of communication regarding a shipping update for your wallpaper. We apologize for the inconvenience that this caused you. We can see that the FedEx tracking link is showing that your order was delivered recently, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
